manifest.diagnosticSource: Working-tree observer only; immutable production refs above

method.units: bytes and milliseconds; report prose uses decimal MB
method.gc: --expose-gc in independent diagnostic only. Three collections after original tests plus 20s idle; none during original workload.
method.peaks: OS maxRSS at suite_end is the original workload high-water. Other peaks are samples at clone/schema/trip boundaries, not guaranteed instantaneous heap maxima.
method.contextStress: 60 read-only re-parses of the real funded 800+2000 records with distinct diagnostic campaign contexts. Not additional commands or a formal Gate.
caveats: Single test file permits at most 2 workers but has one active file worker; this does not reproduce concurrent full-suite contention.
All workers share cgroup quota 2 CPU / 8GiB. Runs are sequential, no concurrent browser/benchmark.
A1 config predates adding the inactive legacy CPU-plugin import in the parent. Active normal worker instrumentation is unchanged; do not treat small timing differences as precise speedup.
Natural idle GC timing varies. Post-GC heap is diagnostic live-heap evidence, not a production forced-GC technique.
CPU controls include Inspector and legacy profiling wrappers; n=1 is a tool-overhead probe, not a statistical comparison.
No Android/native-browser memory result is claimed.
